# Planning

## Goal

Convert the current design into ordered, verifiable work.

## Procedure

1. Read the task and inspect the repository to distinguish existing components from proposed ones.
2. Divide the authorized scope into steps with file areas, feature IDs, prerequisites, and expected outcomes.
3. Include meaningful verification for access boundaries, persistence, error states, and AI behavior when affected.
4. Identify migrations or external dependencies without presuming access or permission.
5. Update [Copilot_Planning.md](../TaskLogs/Copilot_Planning.md). Preserve relevant prior decisions and explain changes to the plan.

## Output

An executable plan with dependencies and verification. Do not invent runnable commands when the toolchain is absent.
